entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Emit a null check in the compiler-synthesized inline-array helpers (`InlineArrayElementRef` / `InlineArrayAsSpan`) #84344
  • Watch/QuickWatch should disambiguate base EIMI and the reimplementation(s) #84342
  • Machine #84341
  • Cleanup VSSDK008: Avoid UI thread affinity in MEF Part construction #84333

Closed

  • Razor: VS error bar "Razor SemanticTokens Feature" is currently unavailable due to an internal error #84104
    18.9

    Needs API Review, VSCode, Area-Razor

    Area-Compilers
